read_audio_with_AudioFile: use AudioFile to read audio from any ffmpeg supported format with optional resampling and mono conversion
convert_audio_channels: convert audio tensor channels by downmixing to mono, replicating mono to stereo, or selecting first N channels
convert_audio_samplerate: convert audio from one sample rate to another using julius resample_frac and adjust channels
prevent_clip_audio: prevent audio clipping using rescale, clamp, or tanh strategies on a float tensor waveform
save_audio: save a torch tensor waveform to mp3, wav, or flac with automatic clipping prevention and configurable bitrate
